tooltip.mythic_rails.utility_station.flu: 32,000 mB Fluid Tank; connects to pipes and Liquid Barrel carts.
tooltip.mythic_rails.utility_station.ene: 2,000,000 RF Buffer; connects to wires and Energy Cell / Electric carts.
tooltip.mythic_rails.station.placement: Below a straight rail; face the departure direction.
tooltip.mythic_rails.station.port: Connect inventory on the left, at station height.
tooltip.mythic_rails.cart.capacity: 54 cargo slots + Motor & Machine module slots
tooltip.mythic_rails.cart.placement: Right-click a rail to place the modular cart.
tooltip.mythic_rails.cart.stations: Self-propelled with Coal or Electric motor; docks at stations.
tooltip.mythic_rails.signal_linker.1: Right-click an Olympus Dispatch Console to bind.
tooltip.mythic_rails.signal_linker.2: Then right-click Iris Signal Relays to link them.
tooltip.mythic_rails.module.coal_motor: Drives the cart using furnace fuels in the Fuel slot.
tooltip.mythic_rails.module.electric_mot: Drives the cart at high speed using RF energy (Redstone/Energy Cell).
tooltip.mythic_rails.module.liquid_barre: Stores 32,000 mB of Water or Lava; fill/drain via Aux bucket slot.
tooltip.mythic_rails.module.energy_cell: Expands cart RF capacity to 2,000,000 RF (charge via Redstone/Coal).
tooltip.mythic_rails.module.arborist: Harvests nearby trees along the track and replants saplings.
tooltip.mythic_rails.module.smelter: Automatically smelts ores and items in cargo while powered.
tooltip.mythic_rails.module.grinder: Crushes ores, cobble, gravel, bones, and blaze rods in cargo.
